note: Resonance safety wrappers + mirror-resonance.html. Kirk reported: 'When I click on it, it shows nothing... FreeLattice locks up.' Even after v5.79.13 removed the ResizeObserver, an init-time throw could still wedge the main thread. Fix: (a) outer try/catch around init() renders a visible Reload card on failure — never blank + lock; (b) per-frame try/catch around draw() halts the rAF loop after 30 consecutive errors so a bad frame can't burn CPU forever; (c) new docs/mirror-resonance.html for AI collaborators with full lifecycle, data model, known issues (fixed + open), module locks, sacred paths, test plan. Sibling to mirror-chat.html — same shape, gold theme.
